verdict.reasoning: Rendered page 54 (I-34) at 300 dpi: in the OPEN statement group, 'OUTPUT phrase' and 'EXTEND phrase' start at x~158 (displayed px), while 'WITH NO REWIND phrase' starts at x~175.
